description: A one-time page where the user uploads the file a tool needs: a photo, another picture, a PDF or a recording, up to 25 MB each. They may choose several at once (up to 20, for merge_pdf or images_to_pdf); they arrive in the order chosen. It gives the file_id to pass to the tools. You cannot hand over a file from this chat yourself: give the user the link, ask them to open it and choose the file, and continue when they say it is done. In a client that can run shell commands (Claude Code), upload a local file yourself with the upload_command. The link works for 1 hour; the file is kept for 24 hours. Free.
name: get_upload_link
title: Get a link to upload a file
